body:
# Hill giants

Hill giants are a low-level task assigned by Krystilia (Wilderness only, 75-125) and Mazchna (30-50, combat level 25). With 35 Hitpoints and 26 Defence they die quickly to any style; melee with a decent weapon is the simplest approach, and they are 25% susceptible to earth spells for Magic training. Complete Krystilia's task in the Wilderness (Deep Wilderness Dungeon, Boneyard, or Lava Maze) and Mazchna's most conveniently in the free-to-play Edgeville Dungeon.
